name: COMP_049
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (76%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged reliability and InSitu/Invasive set [F1] require deferring frozen-section margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 76%, Invasive 13%, Normal 9%, Benign 2% (ECE 5%) | Favors InSitu; 13% invasive |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test, n=132) | Cannot exclude invasion |
| Reliability / OOD | 33% reliability (flagged), 78% OOD [F6] (AUROC 0.70) | Suspect input; low reliability |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 InSitu (20%) [F5]; top Normal (84%) | Neighbors mostly disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Lowers risk [F2]; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Lowers risk [F3]; 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Below-typical [F4]; descriptive (8/20 check) · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 6, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Raises risk; 3/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 regions drops risk above random (CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Poor quality masks invasion in regions 6, 7, 11 (recut, deeper levels drafted).
- Benign left half dilutes right-half carcinoma on composite slide (4/5 neighbors non-InSitu).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 7, 11**: Highest invasive risk (54%, 45%, 31%); check for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 10, 11**: Check ductal atypia and inferior/lateral margins (97%, 90%); defer margins.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 8, 9**: Review benign left half and quality for drafted recut/levels.
